Order 
This is the first application under Section 483 of BNSS filed for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.381/2016 registered at Police Station Kotwali Anuppur, District Anuppur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 34 of IPC and Section 6 of M.P.
Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000.

sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 01.08.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that he along with other co-accused persons cheated and defrauded 103 beneficiaries.
On the basis of which, offence was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that co-accused Manoj Bhadoriya and Ravikant Pal have already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 26.08.2019 in M.Cr.C. No.23013/2019.
Applicant is in custody since 01.08.2025.
There is no previous criminal record of the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55681 2 MCRC-38508-2025 has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,

1 application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
